import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    """
    Optimized model with custom CUDA operators for HardTanh activation.
    Uses element-wise addition for batch processing and custom CUDA kernel for efficiency.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super(ModelNew, self).__init__()
        
        # Define a custom CUDA kernel for HardTanh activation
        # This kernel performs element-wise hard tanh operation on input tensor
        
        def hard_tanh_kernel(input_tensor):
            """
            Custom CUDA kernel for HardTanh activation.
            """
            size = input_tensor.numel()
            block_size = 256
            num_blocks = (size + block_size - 1) // block_size
            
            # Initialize output tensor with zeros
            out = torch.zeros_like(input_tensor)
            
            # Launch kernel to perform hard tanh operation
            # Each thread computes the hard tanh of a single element
            elementwise_add_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(input_tensor.data_ptr<float>(), 
                                                  input_tensor.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<float>(), size)
            
            return out

        self.hard_tanh = torch.nn.functional.hardtanh  # Standard PyTorch implementation
        # But we'll use our custom kernel for optimization

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Applies HardTanh activation to the input tensor using custom CUDA operators.
        
        Args:
            x (torch.Tensor): Input tensor of any shape.

        Returns:
            torch.Tensor: Output tensor with HardTanh applied, same shape as input.
        """
        # Use our custom kernel for efficiency
        return self.hard_tanh_kernel(x)

    def hard_tanh_kernel(self, input_tensor):
        """
        Custom CUDA kernel implementation for HardTanh activation.
        
        This kernel performs element-wise hard tanh operation on the input tensor.
        """
        size = input_tensor.numel()
        block_size = 256
        num_blocks = (size + block_size - 1) // block_size
        
        # Initialize output tensor with zeros
        out = torch.zeros_like(input_tensor)
        
        # Launch kernel to perform hard tanh operation
        elementwise_add_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(input_tensor.data_ptr<float>(), 
                                                  input_tensor.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<float>(), size)
        
        return out

# Define the custom CUDA kernel for element-wise addition (for batch processing)
elementwise_add_source = """
#include <torch/extension.h>
#include <cuda_runtime.h>

__global__ void elementwise_add_kernel(const float* a, const float* b, float* out, int size) {
    int idx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (idx < size) {
        out[idx] = a[idx] + b[idx];
    }
}

torch::Tensor elementwise_add_cuda(torch::Tensor a, torch::Tensor b) {
    auto size = a.numel();
    auto out = torch::zeros_like(a);

    const int block_size = 256;
    const int num_blocks = (size + block_size - 1) / block_size;

    elementwise_add_kernel<<<num_blocks, block_size>>>(a.data_ptr<float>(), b.data_ptr<float>(), out.data_ptr<float>(), size);

    return out;
}
"""

elementwise_add_cpp_source = (
    "torch::Tensor elementwise_add_cuda(torch::Tensor a, torch::Tensor b);"
)

# Compile the inline CUDA code for element-wise addition
elementwise_add = load_inline(
    name="elementwise_add",
    cpp_sources=elementwise_add_cpp_source,
    cuda_sources=elementwise_add_source,
    functions=["elementwise_add_cuda"],
    verbose=True,
    extra_cflags=[""],
    extra_ldflags=[""]
)

class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super(ModelNew, self).__init__()
        
        # Define the custom CUDA kernel for element-wise addition
        elementwise_add = elementwise_add

    def forward(self, a: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Applies element-wise addition to the input tensor.
        
        Args:
            a (torch.Tensor): Input tensor of any shape.

        Returns:
            torch.Tensor: Output tensor with element-wise addition applied, same shape as input.
        """
        return self.elementwise_add(a)
